description: This file defines the ReadableShippingSummary class, a Java class that encapsulates shipping summary details for an e-commerce application, including shipping costs, options, and related information.

classes.name: ReadableShippingSummary
classes.description: A Java class representing a shipping summary with various attributes such as costs, options, and flags indicating free shipping and tax applicability.
